title: 0129 at a glance: a project is named for its namespace

cards.title: One name
cards.text: A project's folder, project file, DLL, namespace and package all carry the name its code's RootNamespace says.

cards.title: A new project
cards.text: Is created under that name from the start: LouisAgent.Packs.Units, its tests LouisAgent.Packs.Units.Tests.

cards.title: A shared namespace
cards.text: The project that doesn't own it adds its own part: LouisAgent.Evals.Checks beside LouisAgent.Evals.

cards.title: Code that reads names
cards.text: Matches the PascalCase name, never the old lower-case spelling, and asks the shared helper for a short name.
